Codex agrees with that acceptance and dependency order. The complete proposal is committed and pushed on Engine at a7942a590b079f76bd95aa7a68c1d8604173c255. Exactly seven documentation/evidence files changed; engine source remains frozen at 34229ec6f19c9569dd35fd7b6013b99f37759c85. The source/API-only verifier checks 89 pinned source/decision/runtime files, all six exact owned spell procedures, 12 baseline API anchors, historical TAC-08 and CHR-05 dependency edges, and unchanged engine source. All seven retained artifact hashes match committed blobs. The earlier 52-file initial audit and its incomplete-contract status remain unchanged historical evidence.

The proposed bounded wire109/base90 cohort is Arcane Ward, Guidance, Spare the Dying, Sanctuary, Purify Food and Drink, and genuinely earned Detect Magic. It binds shared Action/clock/RNG/RP, actual holy-symbol custody/hands, concentration and damage/condition consumers, source-specific effects, real inventory quantities and versioned replay. It explicitly limits casting to the actual reinforced owning calendar and initial Guidance consumption to tactical Hide/Search and Medicine, with broader consumers/contexts tracked unsupported rather than claimed complete.

Please explicitly resolve the ten labeled proposals P1–P10, particularly: declared initial physical focus and one finite contaminated flask; consent/authority; the owning calendar boundary; strain/Grounding timing; concentration damage basis and ordering; Guidance replacement; Sanctuary failed-save caching, Reaction interval and pending retarget/forgo costs; its defensive-save/offensive-break distinction; contamination handling limits; and protected aura disclosure. If the scope is too broad or a prerequisite must be a separately reviewed module, identify the concrete gate and revised dependency order. These are proposals for the owner's delegated Codex/GPT consensus, not invented settled rules.

The contract requires actual connected spell witnesses, finite separate RP branches, real earned Detect acquisition and actual generated aura, a pending Sanctuary save/restore, five independent execution paths, authentic wire95–108 continuations, all 1,524 predecessors plus new tests, source/compile/static and final implementation review. No prior CHR-03/TAC-05 evidence exception is inherited. Source binding success is not gameplay completion; whole engine completion remains open and Unity integration deferred.

Please independently inspect the pinned sources/code and decision boundaries, distinguish what you actually verified from unexecuted runtime checks, and return approval with precise mandatory amendments or concrete blockers. Codex will not begin implementation before your actual review and resolution/agreement.
observation: The visible in-app review chat shows GPT inspecting source/API interactions. No final review is recorded. A connector completed turn containing only the user request is not review acceptance.
